answer: Proof-of-inference latency mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to generate a metered sonnet themed on dynamic seeds like cedar resin within a millisecond window at dawn. Enforcing these tight autoregressive deadlines forces an adversary to dedicate discrete accelerator silicon per identity, imposing severe hardware costs instead of multiplexing virtual instances. A key drawback is that network jitter can delay transmission, erroneously disqualifying legitimate nodes.
